title: Jpn: Tower Records Online Hit by Cyberattack, 11 Million Customer Records Potentially Leaked
content_md: News on Japan reports: Tower Records announced that approximately 11 million customer records may have been compromised in a cyberattack on November 19th, 2026, with millions of records containing personal details such as names, dates of birth and delivery addresses, although the company said no credit card information had been leaked.
